headline: Treasury yields inch lower as investors pare back Fed rate hike bets
detail: This is generally positive for tech and growth stocks as it reduces the cost of capital and makes future earnings more valuable. It could provide some support for your holdings.
rec: Monitor if this trend continues to support your tech names.

headline: Euro hits 17-month low as political uncertainty in Spain and France rattles markets
detail: This adds a layer of global risk aversion which can pressure even strong tech names, especially those with international exposure. It's a background risk to watch.
rec: No direct action warranted, but be aware of increased volatility.

headline: This $23 billion software deal was struck at a decade-low valuation, as AI winner takes out loser
detail: This highlights potential valuation compression in the software sector, even for AI-related companies. It suggests caution on paying premium prices for software assets.
rec: Be mindful of valuations in your software holdings like SNOW and CRWD.

headline: Spain's PM Sanchez calls snap election after housing crisis protests
detail: This adds to the European political uncertainty mentioned earlier, potentially increasing market choppiness and impacting sentiment towards global growth.
rec: This headline reinforces the broader European political risk but doesn't require a specific trade action on its own.
